governance.voting_structure: Une action une voix (classe unique d'ordinary shares) : chaque ordinary share donne droit a une voix sur chaque resolution.

citations.quote: 10 of 11 director nominees are independent. Our Chair and Chief Executive Officer is the only non-independent director.
10 of 11 director nominees are independent. Our Chair and Chief Executive Officer is the only non-independent director.
At our 2025 Annual Meeting, we received support from approximately 90% of votes cast for our NEOs' compensation.
Holders of ordinary shares of Aptiv PLC are entitled to one vote for each share held of record on the record date.
On that date, 213,141,325 ordinary shares were outstanding. Each ordinary share is entitled to one vote on each matter to be voted upon at the Annual Meeting.
